During the Farewell Hajj the Prophet had the people silenced and told them not to revert to disbelief after him by striking one another's necks.
The Day of Nahr sermon: blood, property and honour are as sacred as that day, month and town; the present must tell the absent; do not strike one another's necks.
At the Farewell Hajj, his only Hajj after migrating, the Prophet warns of the Dajjal, declares blood and property sacred and forbids killing one another; verse 5:3 came at Arafat.
In the Farewell Pilgrimage the Prophet declared blood, property and honour as sacred as that day, town and month, and warned against reverting to disbelief by killing one another.
